cut: Add bounded semantic editors for CNS, CMD, and AIR. Depends on DA29-033, DA29-084, DA29-085, DA29-182.
acceptance: Editors preserve comments/unknown text where promised, show located diagnostics, preview semantic diff, validate before write, undo, reopen, and avoid unsupported silent rewrites.
claimCeiling: unit/static structural closeout; not full product parity
